market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates diverge by research house: $4.46B (2024) to $7.16B by 2033 (Fortune Business Insights); ~$5.1B (2025, ResearchNester); $6.17B by 2030 (MarketsandMarkets); $7.34B (2026) to $10.09B by 2031 (Mordor Intelligence).
exportGeographies: global — HOYA's broader Life Care/vision-care distribution network spans 150+ countries; no IOL-specific export dataset found
globalCompetitors: HOYA Surgical Optics itself (3rd or 4th-largest globally by share, sources disagree)
market.domesticSlice: India cataract burden: ~30.34M prevalence (2018), ~6.66M surgeries performed that year (~22% treated); Aravind Eye Hospital alone performs close to 1M cataract surgeries/year; historical data shows a persistent capacity gap (~3.8M annual incidence vs. ~1.6-1.9M annual surgical throughput)

subSegments.name: Preloaded IOL injector systems
subSegments.note: projected to capture ~72% revenue share of the injector market by 2026, driven by sterility and operational efficiency

structureFacts: Global aging population is the consistently cited structural demand driver across all market reports reviewed
India's cataract-surgery capacity gap (incidence outpacing surgical throughput) suggests unmet demand rather than a saturated market

adoptionStructure.note: Hospital/ASC tender and distributor-agreement driven; surgeon brand preference translates into repeat institutional orders rather than a fixed replacement rate

peers.name: Bausch + Lomb
peers.note: Q4 2025 premium-IOL revenue grew 20% YoY (reported basis); full-year 2025 segment revenue grew ~4% constant-currency vs FY2024

regulatory/clinical affairs (CE, FDA, India CDSCO), ISO 13485-class quality systems
